item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh warming the air in a closed glass tank from below with a small heater. He wonders whether the same particle movement applies inside a solid iron bar heated from below.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Heated air expands, becomes lighter, and rises; cooler air moves down to replace it.
options.B: The lighter heated air sinks, and the cooler air rises to replace it.
options.C: In a solid iron bar heated from below, hot metal particles rise through the bar and cooler ones move down.
options.D: Convection in the tank begins only when the air starts to glow.
